Required to complete [[Horadric]]'s quest, packages of meat give the player a means to "legitimately" sell human flesh to the townspeople. Alternatively, they can be un-bundled for [[raw sliced meat]].

Note: the recipe is unlocked after talking to [[Horadric]] after obtaining the {{Item|Stamp}}. An option to Insert the Stamp then becomes available at the [[Cooking table]], and packages can then be made.
